car_2013_02_003_cmd_parent.sqlite_where: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\OUTLOOK.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Acrobat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\AcroRd32.exe' ESCAPE '\'))

car_2014_04_003_powershell.sqlite_where: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
